messages:
Olivia R: propose extracting probe sanitization + hint derivation into a shared precompute/cache that runtime, console, and sim can consume. reduces duplication.

Diego M: sync vs async? sync adds hop latency, async adds staleness.

Harpreet K: prefer cache-backed async with fast local fallback. runtime checks cache -> if miss compute inline and trigger background refresh.

Olivia R: version hints (v1) and include origin_region and age_ms in response. small schema example: {"route":"r1","penalty":0.2,"expiry_ms":20000}. keep payload minimal.

Diego M: ops note: per-region precompute or include region stamp. suggest same-region TTL=20s, cross-region TTL=5s, and an age-inflation adapter for cross-region hints.

infra-bot: k8s baseline: 2 CPU, 1Gi mem, HPA cpu target 60%. add circuit-breaker + fast-fail to avoid regressing runtime tail.

Harpreet K: perf: cache hit ~1-3ms; full inline compute ~8-15ms p95 for worst-case probe shapes. need benching on realistic workloads.

Olivia R: telemetry: hint_cache_hit_rate, hint_age_ms, fallback_local_compute_count, percent_decisions_changed_when_using_hints. also add an explainer endpoint for console to map hint->decision.

policy-bot: RFC link=https://rfd.internal/hint-precompute required=[api_schema, region_strategy, rollback_plan, telemetry].

Diego M: rollout plan: (1) shadow writes only, (2) read-shadow (runtime reads but still computes and compares), (3) opt-in per-tenant read, (4) global. each stage 48-72h. monitor percent_decisions_changed.

Olivia R: action items: Olivia -> draft RFC + API + versioning; Diego -> bench inline calc and p99 probe shapes; Harpreet -> PoC cache + k8s manifest + chaos tests; infra-bot -> runbook template and resource guidance. check-in Friday. :shipit:
